verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's feature-status docs list refreshable materialized views as supported, and these run SQL on a recurring refresh schedule, a narrow first-party form of recurring jobs. The batch-task runner (docs-15) has pause, retry and cancel controls but no documented scheduling. Interval-based alert rules (docs-21) are monitoring, not general job scheduling. Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows, cron-style scheduling of batch tasks, a way to set up or manage schedules through agent tooling (MCP or CHKit), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
